ideas.name: Heavily shorted stocks underperform (FINRA short volume)
ideas.claim: Quintile sort on prior 5-day shorting flows from FINRA daily short-sale volume; heavily shorted stocks underperform over the next 20 days.
ideas.quote: We find that heavily shorted stocks underperform lightly shorted stocks by an annualized risk-adjusted return of 12.6% (t-statistic = 6.00) for equal-weighted portfolios and by 6.0% (t-statistic = 4.03) for value-weighted portfolios.

rules.entry: each day rank stocks into quintiles on shorting activity of prior five days; skip one day; short top quintile, long bottom quintile

required_data: FINRA daily short sale volume files (free)

ideas.name: Contrarian to 13F-HR buy/sell imbalances
ideas.claim: Compute buy-versus-sell imbalance from quarterly 13F-HR holding changes; trade against its sign for 21-42 trading days after quarter end.
ideas.quote: Betting on a relatively short-term movement of prices against the sign of imbalances results in a profitable strategy especially when using a time horizon between 21 and 42 trading days (corresponding to 1-2 calendar months) after each financial quarter ends.

rules.market: US stocks (13F holdings, threshold N of active funds)
rules.entry: after each quarter end, trade contrarian to sign of 13F imbalance (volume or trades), market-hedged with SPY
rules.filters: at least N funds active in the stock (N 50, 150, 500 tested)

ideas.claimed_result: profitable for 21-42 day horizons, 2013-06-30 to 2021-09-30 (numbers not copied)
